description: A revolving spice rack with a wooden base and top, featuring a metal handle. It has multiple tiers, with each tier holding several spice jars. The jars have a metallic rim and a colored lid, suggesting they contain different spices. The central part of the rack is a reflective cylinder, and the outer structure holding the jars is made of metal. The overall design is compact and functional, suitable for organizing spices in a kitchen or pantry.
